name: qfd_c_ring516

pin_regs.reason: every data input pin i lands directly in the 4 bank slot registers (enable = registered one-hot), every output pin o is the reader's output register (ck_r), rsi_w / rsi_r land in the halves' kept reset copies (qfd_c_land_w1k / r1k, 19 loads): flop-first / flop-last, no combinational in->out path

reset_landing.reason: rsi_w / rsi_r are the region-calendar ring resets; each half re-registers them (rq + one kept copy per 30-bit super-group) on its own clock; the parent delivers them from each region's own equal-depth reset tree

structural_change: QW-CB16REG 10-20 main line (a): every CB16 region crossing becomes ONE hard tile = writer ring qfd_c_land_w1k on the source region clock ck_w + reader qfd_c_land_r1k (incl. its output register) on the destination clock ck_r, W=516, D 4, K 2; 69 crossings, 2 masters.  Why: the flat soft rings gave each region root 6.7k-20.9k ring flops over 1-2 mm -> within-region TT spread 410-813 ps, WNS -1.4..-1.7 ns after 10-16 h (fulln/fullnb/fullm).  Tile gate r0 (108 x 64.8) 10-20: WARN only (util), TT/FF spread 12/12 ps, setup +288 ps, GRT ovf 0; outline now 108 x 43.2.  A split form (reader output register as a separate station) was dropped: a two-domain combinational tile output fails the OT_MULTI_ROOT output-domain contract.  0 added cycles.

job.purpose: CB16 hardened landing ring crossing tile W=516 (x12 in the CB16 parent)
